chunks.content: Minimum bulk diesel order is 500 liters. Orders below 500 liters must be picked up directly from a retail dealer station.
Standard depot delivery time is 24 hours within Dhaka metro and 48 hours for Chattogram, Sylhet, and Khulna divisions.
Current bulk diesel price is 109 BDT per liter and octane is 130 BDT per liter, inclusive of standard VAT.
Depot operating hours are 08:00 AM to 08:00 PM Saturday through Thursday. Emergency hospital and generator dispatch operates 24/7.
Accepted payment methods include bank RTGS transfer, corporate bKash, Nagad, and verified Letters of Credit (LC) for orders above 10,000 liters.
Full order cancellation refund is available if cancelled at least 12 hours before tanker dispatch. After tanker dispatch, a 5% restocking and transport fee applies.
Every delivery tanker is equipped with live GPS Leaflet route tracking and calibrated digital flow meters. Customers receive an OTP to confirm seal integrity upon arrival.
Safety compliance requires underground storage tanks to have valid Department of Explosives certification and fire extinguishers on site before unloading.
Quality claims or fuel contamination reports must be submitted within 6 hours of delivery along with the retention sample seal number.
Dealer portal accounts support 5 RBAC roles: Customer, Super Admin, Dealer, Supplier, and Deliveryman.
